title: Special Regulations for Adult Establishments
previewText: In all districts, a non-conforming use may not be changed, initially or in any subsequent change, to an adult establishment, except as provided in Sections 32-01 or 42-01 (Special Provisions for Adult Establishments).

amendmentHistory.description: AMENDMENT TO DISCONTINUE MORATORIUM ON NEW ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS AND PROVIDE PERMANENT REGULATIONS ON THE SITING OF ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS TO PROTECT AGAINST THEIR ADVERSE EFFECTS WHILE ALLOWING SUFFICIENT ACCESS TO ADULT MATERIALS.
